description: How each corpus fills a unit's jurisdiction, owner and authority tier (Phase 4 spec §5.1). jurisdiction null takes the Phase 2 envelope's value; owner issuer takes the Phase 2 issuer, source_system the bench document's Source line; authority_tier maps the tier_by key of a document (URI family, bench source system or file format) to a tier, and an unlisted key takes the Phase 2 tier.
